correctness.rationale: The resolvent is positive and stochastic; each diagonal strictly decreases to 1/N. Loewner comparison with the c-weight complete graph via an exact quadratic variational formula yields a nonnegative reserve and sharp equality iff the chosen vertex has every incident conductance c. Spectral projectors of multipartite Laplacians give an exact diagonal return identity, its strict ordering by part size, and one positive quadratic root. Proof quantifiers include all connected symmetric weights in [0,c], N>=3. The packaged exact-rational verifier checked 456 connected weighted graphs, 12,616 offdiagonals, 86 multipartite partitions and 270 threshold brackets. Finite tests corroborate rather than prove the infinite statements.

value.rationale: A sharp family-wide timestep safeguard for independent capped graph weights, together with equality networks ranging from stars to cliques and a quantitative graph-deficit margin, addresses a structural positivity design problem. The complete multipartite exact frontier collapses a large heterogeneous part profile to its smallest part, sharply classifying onset and fixed-size partition extrema. It goes beyond recomputing the known complete graph and creates reusable network-design bounds.
